name: The Moon Palace
description: Guanghan Palace, also known as Moon Palace, is a palace located on the moon in mythology and is the residence of Chang'e. It is a palace complex with jade towers and palaces connected to each other, with wisps of smoke entwining around them, like a dream. According to legend, after Chang'e took the elixir, she was reluctant to leave Hou Yi, so she lived in Guanghan Palace, which is closest to the earth. Every year on August 15th, Hou Yi would make moon cakes and place them in the northwest of the house. He would call Chang'e's name continuously and the two would be reunited. Later, the stories of "Chang'e flying to the moon" and "Houyi making cakes" were spread among the people.
